title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
summary: The method separator lines went silent on a whole class when a class without a body sat above it in the same file. A data class written as a header only is exactly that.

highlights.title: Separators come back
highlights.description: A class without a body no longer captures the brace of the class below it, so that class keeps its separator lines.

highlights.title: One false line removed
highlights.description: A line drawn above the first member of a companion object is gone. Android Studio draws none there.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: Restores the separator lines of a class that follows a class written without a body, such as a data class header.
Removes a line that used to appear above the first member of a companion object.
Measured on a real project of 3187 Kotlin files: 15 files change and 37 lines come back, including 5 files where the feature drew nothing at all.
